tasks.label: Diff last commit
tasks.command: mkdir -p diffs && git latexdiff --main LaTeX_Git_IEEE_Paper_Template.tex --whole-tree --latexmk --build-dir build --ignore-latex-errors --output diffs/diff-last.pdf HEAD~1 HEAD

windows.command: if not exist diffs mkdir diffs && git latexdiff --main LaTeX_Git_IEEE_Paper_Template.tex --whole-tree --latexmk --build-dir build --ignore-latex-errors --output diffs/diff-last.pdf HEAD~1 HEAD
